definitions.fieldAttempts: Non7m outcourt attempts; goals linked by action ID. Goalkeeper attempts/goals retained separately.
definitions.roles: Database-native V6/V9/M9/M6/H9/H6/GK positions from retained input ratings; not reconstructed event-time tactical roles.
definitions.losses: Exclusive terminal possession loss; incident events are not added to it.
definitions.referenceGaps: Possession, duration and ordinary free throws retain NO_REFERENCE.
definitions.observationalBands: Single named SHOOTING_PLACEMENT quartiles among active outcourt player-matches, not a hidden overall or a causal comparison.
definitions.whistleRestarts: Actual WHISTLE_RESTART events; not every FOUL incident, including played-on advantage.
